name: Pan-Seared Sea Bass (Request Plain / No Cajun Rub)
whyItWorks: Sea bass is an ultra-flaky, low-fat white fish that digests rapidly — ordering it plain with butter and salt turns a spicy Cajun entrée into a flare-safe protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the sea bass pan-seared PLAIN with olive oil/butter and salt (no Cajun spice rub) and swap the spicy shrimp jambalaya for plain steamed white rice or mashed potatoes.
